options.name: api_version_number
options.description: A specific version number to use for the API call. If not included, will use the highest version by default

options.name: current_password
options.description: V2 api paramter, the iDRAC user current_password.

options.name: id
options.description: The unique identifier of the iDRAC user. The available range is between 3 and 16.

options.name: new_password
options.description: V2 api paramter, the iDRAC user new_password.

options.name: password
options.description: V1 api paramter, the iDRAC user password.

options.name: privilege
options.description: The permissions (privilege) of the iDRAC user

options.name: sn
options.description: The serial number of the host to be queried

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for updating iDRAC user account, the default value is 60 seconds

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System
